advisories: Due to extraordinary circumstances, and for reasons of safety, attention all aircraft operators by order of the FAA Command Center, all airports are ground stopped, all departing traffic should remain ground stopped until further notice. Inbound international flights will be handled on a case-by-case basis.

There has been a temporary telecommunications outage - out of an abundance of caution, all flights have been halted. Every flight has been accounted for, and international flights will be handled on a case-by-case basis.
